title: A Falsified Bar-Instability Criterion Reveals an Independent Disk-State Parameter from EFC-Modified Disk Kinematics
abstract: This Stage-1 empirical test falsifies an EFC-modified Toomre-Q bar-instability criterion on SPARC galaxies (AUC 0.22–0.31; anti-correlated with bar truth within the physically allowed ζ range). In the same data, the minimum ΠEFC within the disk window shows strong, replicable correlations with disk structural state (anti-correlated with stellar surface density and positively correlated with gas fraction) across SPARC and xGASS, motivating Πmin as a candidate disk-state parameter on the joint (Σ, fgas) manifold.
